name: Post a daily competitor news digest to Slack with looot Google News search

parameters.content:
## Daily competitor news digest in Slack

### How it works
1. Every morning at 8, the workflow runs one Google News search per competitor through looot.
2. It keeps up to 3 articles per competitor that it has not sent before.
3. It posts one Slack message with the new articles and what the searches cost. No new articles, no message.

Sent links are remembered in the workflow's static data, which n8n keeps only for active workflows. Manual test runs do not remember them.

**Cost per day**, from looot's public catalog on 2026-10-31: news search $0.001 per call. Three competitors cost $0.003 a day, about $0.09 a month. Each call is capped at $0.05.

### Setup
- Needs the verified community node **n8n-nodes-looot** (built against 0.1.4): Settings > Community nodes > Install, search `looot`. [Install guide](https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/verified-install/)
- looot: sign up at [looot.ai](https://looot.ai), top up (from $5), create an agent token under Settings > Agent tokens, then add a **looot API** credential in n8n.
- A Slack credential with chat:write, and the bot invited to the channel. Set the channel ID in **Post to Slack**.
- List your competitors in **Competitors**.

### Customization
Change PER_COMPETITOR in **Build the digest**. Add product names or founders to the list to catch more mentions.

## One news search per competitor
Edit the list in Competitors.

## Only new articles
Links already posted are skipped.
